title: Instant Cashout to an External Debit Card (Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro)
content:
**Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** lets a driver cash out available earnings instantly. An instant cashout to an external debit card is the driver's own act; when the driver asks to cash out as much as possible, the cashout amount is the largest instant cashout, and the driver makes the cashout with that amount and its cashout fee.

A cashout must be at least the smallest instant cashout of the product's cashout schedule and no more than the available balance, and at most the schedule's daily number of cashouts are made per calendar day in the driver's market time. Each cashout books one fee row; cashouts to the Wayfare debit card cost the Wayfare debit card cashout fee of the schedule.

The largest instant cashout is worked out only after the earnings statement carries a bonus entry for the most recently ended quest whose trip target was reached and whose payout date has passed.
## Who does what

| Part | By whom |
|---|---|
| Deciding to cash out, and making the cashout | The driver |
| Unlocking the cashout tool and handing it over | The agent |

## Tool reference: `cash_out_to_debit_card_82ffed45`

**Capability.** Cashes out driver earnings instantly to the external debit card on file for the driver's own earnings account. One call makes one instant cashout of the stated amount and books its cashout fee: the earnings statement shows the cashout and its fee entry, both dated now and sent to the external debit card, and the available balance goes down by the amount plus the fee.

**How it is invoked.** This is the driver's own tool: the agent unlocks `cash_out_to_debit_card_82ffed45` and hands it over, and the driver, the customer themselves, runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `earnings_account_id` | The reference number of the driver's own earnings account being cashed out from, as shown by the earnings account lookup | Identifier |
| `amount` | The amount cashed out to the external debit card, in USD | A positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent (for example 412.65) |
| `fee_amount` | The cashout fee booked for this cashout, in USD | A non-negative amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 when the cashout is free |

**Return.** On success the receipt shows `cashout_entry_id` (the reference number of the cashout on the earnings statement), `fee_entry_id` (the reference number of its fee entry), `status` "sent", `amount` and `fee_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `cashout_channel` "external_debit_card" and `available_balance` (the USD balance after the cashout and fee, 2 decimal places).

## Hypothetical receipt

A cashout run with an `amount` of 412.65 and a `fee_amount` of 0.00 from an account holding 412.65 returns `status` "sent" and `available_balance` "0.00".
